## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why the change is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Production browser smoke test (`npm run test:build && npm run test:e2e`) when UI behavior changes
- [ ] Failure paths and security boundaries have tests
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when behavior or release risk changes

## Risk

Call out changes to filesystem access, job lifecycle, process management, downloads, model execution, packaging, or
performance budgets.
